name: @pipeworx/mcp-eu-pesticides

tools.name: eu_pesticide_substance
tools.description: EU approval record for one pesticide (plant-protection) active substance from the European Commission EU Pesticides Database: approval status (Approved / Not approved / Pending), an explicit approval_state that flags an Approved entry whose expiry date has already passed, first-approval date, expiry date, the governing Commission regulations and directives (links to EUR-Lex; this is how to see whether and under which implementing regulation an approval was renewed or extended), rapporteur member state, candidate-for-substitution and low-risk flags, ADI / ARfD / AOEL reference values, CLP classification, national authorisations and MRL residue definitions. Look up by name (exact, then partial), CAS number or substance id. Returns data_as_of with every answer. Keyless.

name.description: Active substance name, e.g. "dimethachlor", "glyphosate", "chlorpyrifos". Exact match preferred; otherwise partial matches are listed.

tools.name: eu_pesticides_list
tools.description: List EU pesticide active substances by approval status and dates -- e.g. approvals expiring before a date (expiring_before), all substances still Approved, Not approved, or Pending, candidates for substitution, low-risk substances, or one category (fungicide, herbicide, insecticide...). Each row carries status, approval_state (flags Approved entries whose expiry date has passed), first-approval date and expiry date. Sorted by expiry date for date filters, otherwise by name. Source: European Commission EU Pesticides Database; data_as_of in every answer. Keyless.

expiring_before.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD: only Approved substances whose expiry date is on or before it (includes ones already lapsed).

expiring_after.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD: only substances whose expiry date is on or after it.

category.description: Substance category text, e.g. "fungicide", "herbicide", "insecticide", "plant growth regulator".

candidate_for_substitution.description: Only substances flagged as candidates for substitution.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-eu-pesticides forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the eu-pesticides pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
